articles.title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
articles.snippet: THORChain node operators paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron.

articles.title: THORChain founder rejects freeze request, CZ thanks Secret Service: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: Binance has reopened withdrawals following the world’s biggest ever hack, and THORChain co-founder argues it should not halt the protocol to comply with FBI demands.
